turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on the present continuous (am/is/are + -ing)?
turns.tutor:
Example: Mia is reading a book.
Rule: to say what happens now, use am, is or are and add -ing to the action word.
Right: Tom is eating an apple. Wrong: Tom eating an apple.

Now you try. Imagine a park. Write two sentences about what people are doing now.
